fields.content: Four-layer design: skills, scripts (6), hooks (2), enforcement (13+Rust). Dual fence masking impls. 62-node impact graph. Empty baseline/patterns/living-punchlist.
856 passed, 1 skipped, 80% coverage, ruff clean, mypy clean. CI: ci.yml + release.yml.
Churn: lens_quiz(6), _sahjhan_bootstrap(6). Cold ratio 9.5%. 2 cold files: _resolve.py, profiler_plugin.py.
Enforcement layer is primary risk surface. README churn high. Dual fence masking impls remain divergent.

7 predictions: P1 README stale (HIGH), P2 bootstrap bypass (HIGH), P3 quiz edge (LOW), P4 cache parse fragile (MED), P5 README counts (HIGH), P6 _resolve gap (MED), P7 fence masking divergence (HIGH).

fields.evidence: Same as line 190. Both instances stale.
Actual coverage is 80%. Badge says 76% — stale, understates actual.

fields.description: Badge claims 857 tests passed but actual is 856 passed + 1 skipped. Badge also claims 76% coverage but actual is 80%.
Two instances of stale line count: claims 19,446 lines but actual is 19,735 (delta +289).

SKILL.md CLI examples omit required event fields. finding_resolved example (L87) missing project/run/auditor/phase/step. recon_step example (L119) missing project/run/auditor/phase. justine_dispatched example (L128) missing project/run/auditor. Commands will fail with missing field errors.

_sahjhan_bootstrap.py contains _check_bash_write and _bash_references_guarded for Bash commands but hooks.json only configures it for Write|Edit and Read. Bash writes to enforcement/ and read-guarded paths (session.key, quiz-bank.json) are not preventively blocked. Caught reactively by bash_guard PostToolUse manifest verify, but the write already occurred.

Newline bypass in _check_bash_write: re.split pattern does not split on bare newlines. Multi-line bash commands bypass all startswith-based write detectors (cp, mv, install, dd, python3, wget). Real security bypass.
wget --output-document=PATH (equals form) bypasses write detection. Only short form -O is handled.
No curl handler in _check_bash_write. curl -o and curl --output to protected paths are undetected. Redirect form (curl > file) is caught.

PAT-001: parse_lens_name and parse_answers operate on raw message without mask_fenced_blocks. Code block containing LENS: prefix triggers quiz gate for non-lens subagents. mask_fenced_blocks available in _common but never called.

Dual-parser divergence: parse_answers returns lens name but it is discarded at L450. If message has two LENS: lines with different names, questions are selected for one lens but answers scored against another.

Phase Index table uses 5 nonexistent state names: initialized (actual: idle), auditing (actual: audit), merging (actual: merge_ready/merge_done), converging (actual: all_perspectives_clean), finalizing (actual: finalized). Operators matching sahjhan status output to Phase Index will find no matches.
sahjhan ledger checkpoint example missing required --name flag. Command will error at runtime with missing required argument.
sahjhan set complete perspective example missing required MEMBER positional argument. Should be sahjhan set complete perspective <lens-name>.
Run count contradiction: L160 says Twenty-seven runs but L190 says After 28 runs. Internal inconsistency in same section.
Line count stale: README claims 19649 but actual Python line count is 24071. Same class as BH-001/BH-002.

Circuit breaker claims inaccurate: max 3 attempts per item is advisory only (no enforcement gate in transitions.toml). Stall threshold is 15 non-productive commands, not 3 iterations as stated. README implies enforcement that does not exist.
is_sahjhan_cmd returns True if ANY segment of chained command is sahjhan. commit_gate exits OK for entire command, so git commit; sahjhan status bypasses unregistered-commit block.

fields.description: Substring check 'fix_commit in cmd' matches anywhere in full command string. A sahjhan command with fix_commit in a ledger name or option value would incorrectly clear unregistered_commits.
MANAGED_FILES and MANAGED_DOCS are identical lists maintained independently in two files. No test or import ensures they stay in sync. Adding a managed file to one but not the other creates a bypass.

Self-referential deadlock: sahjhan render operations modify managed files (STATUS.md, PUNCHLIST.md), triggering bash_guard manifest violations. Violations are permanent (no resolution pathway per events.toml). 46 violations accumulated in this run, permanently blocking convergence. The enforcement engine cannot converge on itself.
